question: Ramesh Bais served as Governor in which of the following states before being appointed as Governor of Maharashtra in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ramesh Bais:-**

 
 
• **He served as Governor of Jharkhand before being appointed as Governor of Maharashtra in 2023.**
 
• He served as the 10th Governor of Jharkhand from August 2018 to June 2021.
 
• Prior to that, he was a member of parliament from Chhattisgarh and served as a minister in the central government.
